text: file paths absolute. Build index directory yet exist: Align single-end paired FASTQ. SAM, native mapping metrics, , paired input, insert-size statistics written beside output_sam.
code: library(Rdragmap)  native <- rdragmap_executables() built <- rdragmap_build_index(   reference_fasta = "/data/reference.fa",   index_directory = "/data/reference.rdragmap",   executables = native,   threads = 2L,   write_uncompressed = TRUE ) stopifnot(!rdragmap_is_error(built)) aligned <- rdragmap_align(   index = built@index,   read1 = "/data/reads_1.fastq.gz",   read2 = "/data/reads_2.fastq.gz",   output_sam = "/data/sample.sam",   executables = native,   read_group_id = "sample-1",   sample_name = "sample-1",   threads = 2L,   mmap_reference = TRUE ) stopifnot(!rdragmap_is_error(aligned))

title: An R Wrapper for Portable DRAGMAP Short-Read Alignment
text: default write_uncompressed = FALSE keeps hash_table.cmp minimizes persistent index size. alignment process decompresses hash table private memory mapping. Set write_uncompressed = TRUE building index reused. also retains hash_table.bin extend_table.bin; passing mmap_reference = TRUE rdragmap_align() maps files directly. avoids per-process hash decompression allows operating system share cached index pages processes. tradeoff disk space. executed hs37d5 index, two additional files occupy 30 GiB, compared 4.0 GiB compressed hash table. index without uncompressed files rejected starting memory-mapped alignment. ordinary compressed path remains available index. documented HG02088 full-exome run, memory-mapped path reduced wall time 193.35 150.55 seconds aggregate CPU time 2767.80 1949.76 seconds. one measured host workload, general speedup claim; see parent repository’s benchmarks/hs37d5-hg02088 record.

title: Build a DRAGMAP v8 reference index — rdragmap_build_index
text: Runs package-owned dragen-os hash-table generator . output directory must already exist; parent must exist. returned index always contains compressed hash table. can also retain much larger uncompressed hash extension tables required memory-mapped alignment.

title: Build a DRAGMAP v8 reference index — rdragmap_build_index
text: reference_fasta Absolute FASTA path. index_directory Absolute, -yet-existing output directory. executables Explicit executable resolution rdragmap_executables(). threads Positive hash-generation worker count. hash_size Hash table size B, KB, MB, GB units. "0GB" requests native automatic size calculation. memory_limit Hash generation memory limit units. "0GB" requests native automatic limit. seed_length Initial seed length. seed_interval Reference positions per seed. mask_bed Empty one absolute BED path passed --ht-mask-bed. decoys Empty one absolute FASTA path passed --ht-decoys. max_multi_base_seeds Empty one non-negative maximum passed --ht-max-multi-base-seeds. write_uncompressed Whether retain hash_table.bin extend_table.bin. files require substantially disk space permit rdragmap_align(mmap_reference = TRUE) without decompressing hash table every alignment process.
